title: Data Architecture Guardrails Catalogue
description: Catalogue of non-negotiable constraints, mandatory standards, and concrete patterns for the Data architecture domain. Aligned to Policy-as-Code conventions (AWS Service Control Policies, Azure Policy).

meta.description: Rules and minimum standards that must be followed in Data Architecture.
purpose: Codifies data compliance requirements — privacy, classification, and retention — in the architecture
Prevents data decisions that create regulatory or security risk
Provides clear enforcement criteria for data architecture review
Makes data quality standards enforceable rather than aspirational
Supports automated guardrail checking during decision governance

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

rule.description: The mandatory constraint or required pattern

scope.description: What the rule applies to (systems, environments, data classifications, etc.)

rationale.description: Why this is mandatory — often references a principle or compliance requirement

enforcement.description: How compliance is checked (automated scan, review gate, manual audit, etc.)

exception-process.description: How an exception can be raised (or 'No exceptions')
